parameters.name: DeleteWithInstance
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the disk to be attached is released with the instance. Valid values:

*   true: The disk will be released when the ECS instance is released.
*   false: The disk will be retained when the ECS instance is released.
*   If you leave this parameter empty, the default value is used.

parameters.name: DiskId
parameters.description: The ID of the disk to be attached. The cloud disk and the instance must belong to the same node.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens attach-disk --disk-id d-5saf13yy6sopmmg88mzsg0000 --instance-id i-5rr19av7tkpgi9os52ag10000 --delete-with-instance false --region cn-hangzhou
